limitations: The two analytical blank runs (Fusion_201127_05, Fusion_201127_09; RAW sample name 'Blank 0.2%FAE') hold no sample and are not rows of this SDRF.
Each pulldown was run once (one IER3-AS1 and one LacZ sample), so there is no biological replication; both rows carry biological replicate 1.
HeLa donor age (30Y6M) and sex are taken from Cellosaurus, not from the paper.
The bait is antisense DNA oligonucleotides hybridising to an RNA (ChOP), not a protein; it is recorded in a custom characteristics[bait] column.
